subject: Pilot wrap & quick favor — can Uplift be a reference?
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@upliftai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap & quick favor — can Uplift be a reference?

Hi Alicia —

Thank you again for running the two-week pilot with us. Dev and I really appreciated how quickly your team integrated the SDK and ran the benchmark scenarios — we saw the expected throughput improvements and stable latency at tail percentiles. Attached is a short summary and the performance dashboard screenshot for your records.

Key highlights from the pilot (Uplift AI / Redwood Inference):
- 2.2x improvement in median generation latency for internal routing compared to your previous setup (p95 reduced from 480ms → 210ms)
- Sustained throughput of ~420 tokens/sec for the user workload shape measured (steady-state)
- Prefix caching reduced repeated-token cost by an estimated 18% for sampled flows

Would you be open to two small favors that would really help our case-study work?
1) A 10–15 minute reference call (we can keep it brief, record if that helps) — just to confirm impact and context for a short quote.
2) A one- or two-sentence quote we can use in marketing (metrics + value statement is great, e.g., “X reduced latency / improved quality / lowered inference costs”).

If you’re comfortable, we can draft suggested wording to save your team time — happy to iterate. Proposed times for a quick call: Tue 04/05 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 04/05 14:00–15:00 PT.

Attachments: uplift_pilot_summary.pdf, perf_dashboard_qps.png

Thanks,
So-

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@upliftai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Benito Ruiz <benito.ruiz@upliftai.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 12:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap & quick favor — can Uplift be a reference?

Hi Soojin (and team),

Thanks — the summary looks accurate and Dev’s tuning made the integration straightforward. Happy to help.

We can do Tue 04/05 at 10:00 PT for a quick call — I’ll be there with Benito (our ML infra lead). Below is a short quote you can use; feel free to tweak and send back for sign-off:

"Working with Redwood Inference during the pilot helped us cut median latency in half while keeping throughput stable; the improvements directly reduced time-to-response in our customer flows." — Alicia Gomez, VP Product, Uplift AI

One small note: please remove the internal cost-savings estimate from public materials — we can discuss cost metrics in the call but prefer not to publish numbers.

See you Tue.

Best,
Alicia

On attachments: happy to provide our logo after we confirm final wording.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Great — thanks for the quick reply and for the draft quote, Alicia. I updated the wording slightly to make it tighter for a one-line marketing blurb; please confirm or suggest edits:

Proposed blurb for review:
"Redwood Inference helped us halve median generation latency while maintaining stable throughput, improving response times for our end users." — Alicia Gomez, VP Product, Uplift AI

We removed the public cost estimate as requested. If that reads ok, would you be willing to: 1) reply with an approval email we can keep on file and 2) attach your company logo (SVG or PNG) so marketing can assemble the asset? I added a short draft brief here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPilotBrief

Call: confirmed for Tue 04/05 at 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent.

Thanks again — we’ll keep the call short and focused on impact/one-line quote.

— Soojin
